current.text: Experts expect him to start for the Lakers and play about 30 minutes. One expert is fairly confident.
The starting spot is not settled. LaRavia or Ziaire Williams could start instead. Whoever comes off the bench is still expected to play about 27 minutes.
Andy expects him to start because he is the team's best point of attack defender who can also score and handle the ball.
In drafts he often goes in round 12.
He is a high-end late flyer. On his own his best case is about top 110.
He is also a handcuff for Doncic and Reaves. If one of them misses time, he becomes the number two option and could have a top 70 run. Another expert puts that upside at top 80.
Doncic's health is seen as a risk for the Lakers, which adds to his handcuff value.
LeBron James and Rui Hachimura left the Lakers. That opens usage for the players who remain.
The Lakers have the second most back-to-backs in the league.
The Lakers play 3-4-3 games in our playoff weeks (March 28 end). That is in the bottom half of the league.

durable.text: When he had big usage running point guard on a tanking Philadelphia team, he scored big and shot very well.
His category profile is balanced, with no big strength or weakness. Threes are his best category and FG% is his weakest.
